description:
Ji-ho, who lives between part-time jobs, recently took a break from work due to a car accident. He took a break for a while, but in the meantime, the rent and hospital bills for his sick sister are huge. Ji-ho, who is in urgent need of money, is thinking about whether he should sell his organs, but Ki-beom, a high school friend, recommends a host club job... There, he meets his first love, Jin-heon Choi, whom he hated the most.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/parallel_L/?p_id=naverblog931), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/parallel_lines)
